about.title: Finance, but make it make sense.
body: Finance Lab by SSEI is the finance-education lab of the Sanjay Saraf Educational Institute. We explain how money, markets and businesses actually work — in plain language, with Indian and global examples.
Read the Daily Brief, test yourself with FinQuest, watch the videos, go deep with our research and catch the quick takes on Instagram and WhatsApp.
